<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Blazing Wave](/Feats.aspx?ID=4240) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Impulse" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=502" />
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
<trait label="Overflow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=506" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 28

</column>

---

Flames flow out of you in a cascade, engulfing everyone in a 30-foot cone. Each creature in the area takes 4d6 fire damage with a [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save against your class DC. A creature that critically fails its save is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31).

---
**Level (+2)** The damage increases by 1d6.
name: Blazing Wave
